note: keydown handler cancels Tab in a text field
two buttons pass focus to each other on Tab and Shift+Tab
outline removed on focus with no replacement
skip link stays off screen when focused
positive tabindex sends focus to row two before row one
flex row-reverse makes focus run right to left
fixed banner covers a focused link below the fold
span with a click listener is not focusable
link removed from the tab order with tabindex=-1
